source.content: System.assertEquals('reports.FeatureNotSupportedException', new reports.FeatureNotSupportedException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('reports.InstanceAccessException', new reports.InstanceAccessException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('reports.InvalidFilterException', new reports.InvalidFilterException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('reports.InvalidReportMetadataException', new reports.InvalidReportMetadataException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('reports.InvalidSnapshotDateException', new reports.InvalidSnapshotDateException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('reports.MetadataException', new reports.MetadataException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('reports.ReportRunException', new reports.ReportRunException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals('reports.UnsupportedOperationException', new reports.UnsupportedOperationException().getTypeName()); System.assertEquals(reports.ReportFilterType.fieldToField, reports.ReportFilterType.fieldToField); System.assertEquals(reports.ReportFilterType.fieldValue, reports.ReportFilterType.fieldValue); Id reportId = '00O000000000001'; reports.ReportMetadata metadata = new reports.ReportMetadata(); reports.ReportResults runDefault = reports.ReportManager.runReport(reportId); reports.ReportResults runDetails = reports.ReportManager.runReport(reportId, true); reports.ReportResults runMetadata = reports.ReportManager.runReport(reportId, metadata); reports.ReportResults runMetadataDetails = reports.ReportManager.runReport(reportId, metadata, true); System.assertEquals(false, runDefault.getHasDetailRows()); System.assertEquals(true, runDetails.getHasDetailRows()); System.assertEquals(reportId, runMetadata.getReportMetadata().getId()); System.assertEquals(true, runMetadataDetails.getHasDetailRows()); reports.ReportInstance asyncDefault = reports.ReportManager.runAsyncReport(reportId); String asyncDefaultId = String.valueOf(asyncDefault.getId()); System.assertEquals('Success', asyncDefault.getStatus()); System.assertEquals(asyncDefaultId, String.valueOf(reports.ReportManager.getReportInstance(asyncDefaultId).getId())); System.assertEquals(1, reports.ReportManager.getReportInstances(reportId).size()); reports.ReportInstance asyncDetails = reports.ReportManager.runAsyncReport(reportId, true); reports.ReportInstance asyncMetadata = reports.ReportManager.runAsyncReport(reportId, metadata); reports.ReportInstance asyncMetadataDetails = reports.ReportManager.runAsyncReport(reportId, metadata, true); System.assertEquals(true, asyncDetails.getReportResults().getHasDetailRows()); System.assertEquals(reportId, asyncMetadata.getReportId()); System.assertEquals(true, asyncMetadataDetails.getReportResults().getHasDetailRows()); System.assertEquals(0, reports.ReportManager.getDatatypeFilterOperatorMap().size()); reports.ReportDescribeResult describe = reports.ReportManager.describeReport(reportId); System.assertEquals(reportId, describe.getReportMetadata().getId()); System.assertEquals(0, describe.getReportExtendedMetadata().getDetailColumnInfo().size()); System.assertEquals(0, describe.getReportTypeMetadata().getStandardFilterInfos().size());
